messages:
anya: heads-up — CI flagged a big regendiff during the latest release candidate for publishflow. sample-app tests failing, looks like generated types changed ordering + a small rename.

Taylor: which rename? semver bump on typegen?

anya: generated client renamed `retryPolicy` -> `retries` in the client schema, and the map key ordering for headers flipped. diff excerpt: 
```
- client.config.retryPolicy: { attempts: 4 }
+ client.config.retries: { attempts: 4 }
- headers: ["x-user", "x-org"]
+ headers: ["x-org", "x-user"]
```

Rico: ugh. Consumers compare snapshots and some sample apps assume stable header order. This is observable behavior so it should be treated as semver-minor unless we revert.

ci-bot: pipeline #5347 failed: regendiff-check (logs: https://ci.redwood/p/5347)

release-bot: temporary unblock suggestion: pin publishflow to typegen@3.2.1 in workspace.lock to skip regen checks until we decide.

Taylor: pinning is OK short-term. We need a crisp policy doc: when generator output changes require a changelog + migration notes and whether to patch-revert.

anya: proposed path: revert rename in a patch to restore compatibility, then release a 3.3.0 with documented rename, migration snippet, and an opt-in flag `--enable-new-retries` for regen so SDK owners can migrate on their cadence.

Kira: also add automated checks: PR template must include `REGEN_NOTE.md` when bumping typegen and CI should fail if regendiff > threshold without a regen note.

Rico: add a golden test in sample-apps that validates header list ordering using a stable-serialization helper to avoid flaky tests.

ops: please also add a short line in onboarding: "Before approving deps bump that touches codegen/typegen, run `yarn regen-check` and add REGEN_NOTE.md describing user-visible changes."

Taylor: I'll draft a small devex doc "Regeneration policy: semver, changelogs, and pinning" with examples for renames, ordering, and auth/retry shape changes. Will include the revert-first pattern and the opt-in flag pattern.

anya: opened PRs: typegen revert: https://github.com/redwood-inference/typegen/pull/942, publishflow pin: https://github.com/redwood-inference/publishflow/pull/120. Kicking CI.

ci-bot: pipeline #5348 started (after pin/revert).

ci-bot: pipeline #5348 passed — pin bypassed regen checks and revert patch builds clean.

Kira: follow-ups assigned: add REGEN_NOTE requirement to release template, add a regen-check example in devex onboarding, and add a unit test asserting stable header ordering. I'll update the release checklist and ping SDK owners.

Rico: thanks — leaving this thread for trace. :white_check_mark:
